visual_action: A fast-paced slideshow of still images alternating between two politicians, Mandela Barnes and Ron Johnson. Barnes is shown in positive contexts: waving at a rally, smiling with young people at a Pride parade, and speaking with a megaphone at another rally. Johnson is shown in more neutral, formal settings, speaking. Text overlays appear on each image, creating a direct comparison of their stances on various issues.
